title: Card Replacement and Delivery Terms by Plan, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account
content:
For a replacement card on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account, each plan (Paystride Visa Payroll Card Essential through Elite) carries the following fees and delivery times. Fees are in US dollars.

| | Essential | Standard | Select | Advantage | Premier | Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Replacement card fee | 5.00 | 5.00 | 5.00 | 4.00 | 3.00 | 0.00 |
| Replacements in 12 months free of the replacement fee (count) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Expedited shipping fee, in addition to the replacement fee | 20.00 | 20.00 | 17.50 | 15.00 | 15.00 | 10.00 |
| Standard delivery of a replacement card, business days | 10 | 10 | 7 | 7 | 5 | 5 |
| Expedited delivery, business days | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Reissue of a card nearing expiry is free | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Comparing plans

- The replacement card fee falls from 5.00 on the Essential, Standard and Select plans to 4.00 on the Advantage plan, 3.00 on the Premier plan and 0.00 on the Elite plan.
- The Premier and Elite plans list 2 free replacements in 12 months, and the other plans list 1.
- Standard delivery takes 10 business days on the Essential and Standard plans, 7 on the Select and Advantage plans and 5 on the Premier and Elite plans. Expedited delivery takes 2 business days on every plan.
